submission_method.quote: Proposals are to be submitted directly through the BCBid platform where the RFP is posted. No physical submission will be accepted unless specifically requested.

contract_term.quote: The term of the licensing and support agreement is to be for a period of five years, with an option in favour of Cowichan Tribes to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions.
contract_term.value: 5 years with an option to extend

scope_of_deliverables.quote: The deliverables for this RFP are detailed in the table below.
scope_of_deliverables.value: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) System implementation and licensing, including data conversion and integration capabilities assessment.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: Each Proposal must also consist of the following components: 1. The Proposal must be received by the Submission Deadline indicated in 1.4 RFP Timetable and must be submitted using the submission method set out in 1.5 Submission of Proposals. 2. The Proposal must be in English. 3. A completed Submission Form in PDF format which is signed by an authorized representative of the proponent described in Appendix C. 4. A completed Narrative Response in PDF format which follows the table contents in Appendix B – Section A. 5. A completed Pricing Excel Workbook described in Appendix B – Section G. Template for workbook provided. 6. A completed Requirements Excel Workbook. Instructions are in the provided requirements workbook.
value: The Proposal must be received by the Submission Deadline indicated in 1.4 RFP Timetable and must be submitted using the submission method set out in 1.5 Submission of Proposals.
The Proposal must be in English.
A completed Submission Form in PDF format which is signed by an authorized representative of the proponent described in Appendix C.
A completed Narrative Response in PDF format which follows the table contents in Appendix B – Section A.
A completed Pricing Excel Workbook described in Appendix B – Section G. Template for workbook provided.
A completed Requirements Excel Workbook. Instructions are in the provided requirements workbook.

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote: The following sets out the mandatory technical requirements of the proponent and the proposed solution: 1. Support for organizations operating in Canada including support for Canadian taxes and Canadian Payroll. 2. Vendor has experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada. 3. The solution must be hosted in Canada and stores all data within Canada. 4. Implementation vendor(s) can demonstrate they have at least five years' experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions. 5. Solution is cloud based. 6. The solutions are SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent.
value: Support for organizations operating in Canada including support for Canadian taxes and Canadian Payroll.
Vendor has experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada.
The solution must be hosted in Canada and stores all data within Canada.
Implementation vendor(s) can demonstrate they have at least five years' experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions.
The solutions are SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent.

minimum_score_threshold.quote: To advance, a proposal must score at least 80% for functional fit. If it falls short, the vendor will be notified of deficiencies and given a rectification period. This process follows mandatory submission requirements in Section C of the RFP Particulars (Appendix B). Proposals still below 80% after rectification will not proceed further.

pricing_structure.value: Proposals must be submitted in PDF format for narrative responses and Excel format for pricing details.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: At the conclusion of the evaluation, Cowichan Tribes will conduct a cumulative assessment and invite the top two or three vendors to provide a demonstration at their discretion.
